name: xn-qol-enhancements
author: Xnuui
description:
[yellow]Features in this mod were listed as [scarlet]PRs[] a while ago. But [scarlet]Anuke[], to this day, has not decided to merge them in, so i made a mod about it.[]

[scarlet]Features included:[]
1. [yellow]Phase Bridge Auto-link[]; Basically how you can do it with normal bridges, but with phase bridges supported too.

2. [yellow]Junction Fix[];
Lets players move a conduit line over a junction, without modifying it back into a normal conduit.

3. [yellow]Total Schematic fix[];
Displays the total schematic size when opening a schematic.
